quarterly_data.quarter: Sanofi press release: Press Release: Sanofi and Cheplapharm to create new (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Sanofi and Cheplapharm announced their intention to create a strategic partnership under which Cheplapharm would take over a selection of 20 mature Sanofi medicines, including Lovenox/Clexane (enoxaparin; excluding in the US), and three manufacturing sites - Csanyikvolgy in Hungary (c.400 employees), Jurong in Singapore (c.100 employees) and Ploermel in France (c.65 employees) - with Sanofi receiving a 26.4% equity stake in Cheplapharm in return. The commercial transfer of the medicine portfolio is planned to begin in the first quarter of 2027, followed by the sites, with the transaction expected to be fully completed by the third quarter of 2027; it is not expected to have any impact on Sanofi's 2026 financial guidance.
quarterly_data.figure: 20 mature medicines and three manufacturing sites to Cheplapharm; 26.4% equity stake; completion by Q3 2027
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: acquirer of divested mature medicines and manufacturing sites
